You have real read_document/read_documents, analyze_csv and search_sources tools. Use read_documents to batch several needed pages in one call, avoiding repeated model round-trips. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The source paper identity is visible. You may use disciplinary reasoning and clearly labelled conditional hypotheses; lack of an external citation does not prohibit a derivation. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit using submit_result; validators return actionable errors in this same conversation. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use an exact S-number from source_bindings and a verbatim quote from that document. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an object of relative artifact paths to complete text content; every declared artifact must exist or be provided in files. If artifacts is empty, your exact summary is saved automatically as an artifact; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. Start with input_refs and inline bodies, not the entire provenance catalog. When reading a needed document, request the relevant JSON pointer or a useful page (up to 12000 characters); avoid repeated tiny probes. For review, source_stage must match the stage containing the exact quote; note_keys are actual memory_notes keys (often empty), not JSON field names. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.
Test the transport. First use read_documents to read BOTH supplied inputs in one batch (even if inlined, this checks batching). Then use analyze_csv on scan=mean_phase to compute mean(S1**2+S2**2+S3**2) and mean(DOP). Submit a concise result with summary string, artifacts/evidence/claims/limitations/next_actions arrays and metrics {total_rows,selected_rows,norm_squared_mean,dop_mean}. Cite tool record paths in evidence. No search needed.
